title: [test] CLI CRUD commands end-to-end
description:
Integration test verifying all five CRUD subcommands against the real NoteAPI.

Files to create:
- tests/cli/crud.test.ts (Jest)

Approach:
- Import the Express app and start it on an ephemeral port with app.listen(0) in beforeAll; tear down in afterAll. Set NOTEAPI_URL to that port. Call noteStore.clear() between tests.
- Invoke the CLI by importing and calling the command handlers directly (preferred) OR by spawning `ts-node src/cli/index.ts <args>` via child_process and asserting on stdout/stderr and exit code.

Assertions (each pass/fail):
- create --title/--content returns exit 0 and emits an id.
- list shows the created note; list --tag filters correctly.
- read --id <created> returns the note; read of a bogus id exits non-zero with a clean `Error:` message (no stack trace).
- update --id changes the title; a following read reflects it.
- delete --id removes it; a following read exits non-zero.
- Missing required flags (e.g. create with no --title) exit non-zero with a clean error.

Done when:
- `npm test` runs the new suite and all assertions pass.
- No test leaves the server listening (clean afterAll).

Depends on all four mi2 impl tasks.

title: [impl] Add NoteAPI HTTP client module
description:
Create a typed HTTP client the CLI commands use to talk to the running NoteAPI.

Files to create:
- src/cli/apiClient.ts  (functions: listNotes(filter?), getNote(id), createNote(input), updateNote(id, input), deleteNote(id))

Behaviour:
- Base URL comes from env NOTEAPI_URL, defaulting to http://localhost:3000. Endpoints target /api/notes.
- Uses global fetch (Node 18+). Reuses the Note/CreateNoteInput/UpdateNoteInput interfaces from src/models/note.ts — no `any` types.
- listNotes accepts optional { tag?, q? } and appends them as query params.
- On non-2xx responses, throws an Error whose message is the API's { error } / { errors } text (never a raw response object or stack trace).
- On network failure (server down), throws `Error: cannot reach NoteAPI at <url>`.

Done when:
- Module exports the five functions with proper types and compiles under `npm run build`.
- `npm run lint` passes.
- Acceptance verified by the CRUD integration test task, not this task.
